1. (Currently amended) A sensor system, comprising: a sensor device having an external surface on which is arranged at least one electrical test contact; and a cover device including at least partially an electrically insulating material, the cover device mechanically connected to the sensor device via an adhesive bond; wherein the cover device is configured to cover the at least one electrical test contact of the sensor device so as to prevent contact from being made to the at least one electrical test contact from outside the sensor system, and wherein the cover device is positioned to maintain a predetermined spacing between the internal surface of the cover device and the at least one electrical test contact.

2. (Currently amended) The sensor system according to claim 1, wherein: the cover device has an internal surface configured to face the external surface including the at least one test contact, and at least one further metallization is arranged on the internal surface in electrical isolation from the at least one electrical test contact, the at least one further metallization configured to be mechanically but not electrically connected to the at least one electrical test contact.

3. (Currently amended) The sensor system according to claim 1, further comprising: at least one electrical connecting contact arranged on the external surface distinct from and separate from the at least one test contact, wherein the cover device is configured to enable electrical contact to be made to the at least one electrical connecting contact from outside the sensor system.

4. (Currently amended) The sensor system according to claim 3, wherein the cover device includes at least one of at least one first opening and at least one via electrically connected to the at least one electrical connecting contact to enable electrical contact to be made from outside the sensor system, and wherein the at least one first opening and at least one via are positioned to avoid the at least one electrical test contact.

5. (Currently amended) The sensor system according to claim 1, wherein: the sensor device includes a sensor substrate configured to form the external surface including the at least one test contact, the cover device includes a cover substrate having a first segment corresponding to the external surface, and the first segment of the cover device and the external surface including the at least one test contact are connected together at least partially through a non-conductive bonding layer.

10. (Currently amended) The sensor system according to claim 1, wherein at least one of the sensor device and the cover device includes an integrated circuit configured to process sensor data and communicate wirelessly.

6. (Previously presented) The sensor system according to claim 5, wherein the cover device includes a second segment configured to bound the first segment and at least partially enclose the sensor device at right angles to the external surface.

7. (Currently amended) The sensor system according to claim 1, wherein: at least one of the sensor device and the cover device includes at least one of an energy storage unit and an energy converter unit integrated within the cover device structure, and the at least one of the energy storage unit and the energy converter unit is configured to be used to supply the sensor device with power through a dedicated electrical pathway.

8. (Currently amended) The sensor system according to claim 7, wherein: the energy converter unit includes at least one of a photovoltaic cell and a thermoelectric generator positioned on an outer surface of the cover device, and the cover device includes at least one corresponding second opening configured to expose the energy converter unit to external environmental conditions.

9. (Previously presented) The sensor system according to claim 8, further comprising at least one of a transparent protective layer and a thermally conductive material introduced at least partially in the second opening.

11. (Currently amended) The sensor system according to claim 1, wherein: the sensor device includes at least one access aperture configured to allow direct access to internal sensor components, and the cover device includes at least one third opening corresponding to the at least one access aperture and configured to align with the access aperture when the cover device is mechanically connected to the sensor device.

12. (Previously presented) The sensor system according to claim 1, wherein at least one of the cover device and the sensor device includes at least one fastening mechanism configured to enable the sensor system to be fitted to another object.

13. (Previously presented) The sensor system according to claim 12, wherein the at least one fastening mechanism is formed as one of a suction pad, a pin, an adhesive surface, a hook-and-loop fastener, an electrostatic pad and a magnet.

14. (Previously presented) A cover device for a sensor system, comprising: a sensor device having an external surface on which is arranged at least one electrical test contact; an at least partially electrically insulating material; and at least one fastening mechanism configured to enable the sensor system to be fitted to another object, wherein the cover device is configured such that, when a mechanical connection is made between the cover device and the sensor device, the cover device covers the at least one electrical test contact of the sensor device to prevent contact from being made to the at least one electrical test contact from outside the sensor system.

15. (Previously presented) The cover device according to claim 14, wherein the at least one fastening mechanism is formed as one of a suction pad, a pin, an adhesive surface, a hook-and-loop fastener, an electrostatic pad, and a magnet.

16. (Previously presented) The sensor system according to claim 10, wherein the integrated circuit is a wireless communications unit for data transmission.
